name: skills
one_liner: A library of cheat-sheets that teach AI coding assistants the correct, modern way to build Android apps, so the AI stops suggesting outdated patterns.
buyer: An Android-focused dev shop that wants its team's AI coding assistants to stop writing code that reviewers have to correct, speeding up pull-request approval.
business_use_cases: A mobile dev agency installs these skills across the team's AI assistants so junior developers' AI-generated code matches Google's current best practices on the first pass.
An Android training bootcamp uses the skills as a built-in tutor that keeps students' AI-assisted code aligned with official guidance.
A plugin marketplace vendor builds a paid 'certified skills' bundle on top, covering more ground and kept current, for teams who don't want to track Google's changes themselves.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid, continuously-updated superset of skills that also bakes in a company's internal coding conventions, sold as a subscription for Android dev teams.

steal_this: Load these skills into your AI assistant on your next real Android feature this weekend and count how many fewer review comments you get.
